packageRules.description: actions/checkout stays on v5: v6 and later are broken on non-GitHub runners, so a major bump is never a valid PR here.
Astro majors move fast and can change routing/content APIs. Never automerge.
TypeScript majors (7.x is the native-port major) are planned deliberately, never automerged.
zod must track the major Astro itself depends on — see src/content.config.ts.
wrangler ships frequently; group it so deploys are not churned one PR at a time.
devDependencies minor and patch carry no runtime risk and are covered by the full check suite; merge them once CI is green.
wrangler is the deploy path itself, so a bump that breaks deploys must never merge itself.
